Topic.label: Integrated Studies and Practice: Optimization Problems in Everyday Life

Question: An item costs 30 yuan to purchase, and 100 units are sold per day when the selling price is 40 yuan. For every 1 yuan increase in the selling price, 5 fewer units are sold per day (the price increase must be an integer number of yuan). Find the maximum daily profit. (Unit: yuan)
Solution: Let the price increase be \(x\) yuan. The profit is \(P=(10+x)(100-5x)=-5x^2+50x+1000=-5(x-5)^2+1125\). The maximum is 1125 when \(x=5\).
